prompt.intent: Use case: illustration-story. One finished LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 children's picture-book illustration, no text, panels, logos or watermark. Input1 current Blender guide is the sole authority for camera, house shape, openings, door states and fixed furniture. Preserve guide perspective and cropping exactly. Other inputs provide ONLY warm tactile book rendering, cast identity and the separately named story prop. Do not copy their old architecture or reposition a modeled window. Golden morning light, warm honey timber/stone/plaster and amber fur/quills, same detailed gentle look as the LAST Bath Magic chapter, not a new cartoon style. Each named hedgehog has one head, two forelimbs, two hindlimbs; dog exactly four attached legs, one head and one curled tail, with believable contact and occlusion. No clothes. Papa is adult grey/chestnut spined cream-faced hedgehog with broad gentle face; Mama is adult russet spined cream-faced mother; PinPin child about HALF adult height; PomPom tiny baby only if explicitly named. Scooby same golden-russet dog with cream muzzle, floppy ears, brown eyes, black rounded nose and feathery curled tail; shoulder approximately1.3 times Papa standing height, never giant paws as big as an adult body. Keep all cast at comparable scale/depth and separate anatomy. No additional cast. After breakfast, Only Mama and PinPin beside the same round table, dishes now gathered on one tray. Mama kneels to softly wipe ONE of PinPin's berry-sticky forepaws with a damp cream cloth; child's other paw rests at his side. Baby and Papa not in shot. The same room, exact camera, CLOSED green door and window positions. A folded ochre towel beside cleared breakfast bowls quietly foreshadows evening care. Unhurried intimate gesture, no bath yet.
